title: SCRIBES: Web-Scale Script-Based Semi-Structured Data Extraction with Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2510.01832v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Semi-structured content in HTML tables, lists, and infoboxes accounts for a substantial share of factual data on the web, yet the formatting complicates usage, and reliably extracting structured information from them remains challenging. Existing methods either lack generalization or are resource-intensive due to per-page LLM inference. In this paper, we introduce SCRIBES (SCRIpt-Based Semi-Structured Content Extraction at Web-Scale), a novel reinforcement learning framework that leverages layout similarity across webpages within the same site as a reward signal. Instead of processing each page individually, SCRIBES generates reusable extraction scripts that can be applied to groups of structurally similar webpages. Our approach further improves by iteratively training on synthetic annotations from in-the-wild CommonCrawl data. translated_title: SCRIBES：基于强化学习的网络规模脚本化半结构化数据提取
translated_abstract: 摘要：HTML表格、列表和信息框中的半结构化内容占据了网络上大量的事实数据，但格式复杂化使得使用困难，从中可靠地提取结构化信息仍然具有挑战性。现有方法要么缺乏泛化能力，要么因逐页的大语言模型推理而资源密集。在本文中，我们介绍了SCRIBES（基于脚本的网络规模半结构化内容提取），一种新颖的强化学习框架，利用同一网站内网页之间的布局相似性作为奖励信号。SCRIBES不是单独处理每个页面，而是生成可重用的提取脚本，这些脚本可应用于结构相似的网页组。我们的方法进一步通过迭代训练来自野外CommonCrawl数据的合成标注来改进。实验表明，我们的方法在脚本质量上优于强基线超过13%，并提升了数据提取效率。
tldr: 本文提出SCRIBES，一种基于强化学习的框架，通过利用网站内布局相似性生成可重用提取脚本，显著提升了网络规模半结构化数据提取的质量和效率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SCRIBES, a reinforcement learning framework that leverages layout similarity within websites to generate reusable extraction scripts, significantly improving the quality and efficiency of web-scale semi-structured data extraction.
